value.rationale: The invariant is a standard sharp geometry measure for Frank–Wolfe convergence. The work classifies the complete Euclidean face-distance spectrum and all global extremizers of an unbounded natural Hanner free-sum family; it proves precise reduction relative to a cube factor and an unexpected independence from the smaller dimension, with a quantified \(q^{-3/2}\) versus \(q^{-1}\) normalized regime.
